changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led Shopify growth-to-catalog handoff with a reviewed edit and measured follow-through.

title: Storefront Opportunity to Verified Change
description: Find a product-page or variant issue, prepare a merchant-reviewed catalog correction, then verify the shipped change and comparable shopper evidence.
setup_prompt: Use Storefront Opportunity to Verified Change as a proposal for one Shopify store, market, buyer task, and product scope. Discover existing Crews and propose reuse or creation of Shopify Growth Analyst and Catalog & Merchandising Analyst. Inspect the public storefront and authorized product, variant, inventory, and analytics sources. Show the typed opportunity-to-catalog handoff, a merchant review of the exact proposed edit, a manual first run, and comparable post-change measurement. Selecting this Playbook does not create Crews, connect accounts, publish a product or theme, spend budget, or enable recurrence. Show the concrete proposal before Builder applies it.

setup_inputs.label: Store, market, buyer task, and product or collection scope
Storefront and authorized product, variant, inventory, and analytics sources
Merchant goal, metric definition or qualitative-only rule, and comparable window
Growth and catalog decision owners and publish policy
Manual-only or reviewed schedule and notification route

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create a reviewed missing Shopify Crew with a stable idempotency key

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass a validated bounded opportunity artifact to the catalog Crew

recommended_tools.name: Shopify Admin or bounded product export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read exact product, variant, collection, and market facts

recommended_tools.name: Public storefront browser
recommended_tools.purpose: Inspect the exact buyer-facing product or collection journey

recommended_tools.name: Authorized analytics report or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Measure a defined segment and event with a comparable denominator

pulse_focus.label: Storefront opportunity follow-through
focus_areas: Whether owner-approved product or variant changes were actually published and retested
Whether comparable shopper evidence supports, contradicts, or cannot resolve the hypothesis
review_when: A catalog change receives an owner decision, a publish receipt arrives, or the agreed measurement window ends

outputs: Reviewed Shopify Crew roster and source map
Catalog correction brief with pending merchant decision
Verified publish evidence and comparable measurement or inconclusive result
